Container.Name: SteamBee
Container.Overview: SteamBee is a self-hosted operations console for managing your own Steam accounts, with a browser UI, multi-account control, QR/mobile approval, encrypted refresh-token storage, recovery tooling, notifications, schedules, and local logs. Legacy playtime boosting is a high-risk compatibility feature and may violate Steam or game-service rules.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: steam account operations self hosted management recovery notifications
Container.Requires: Internet access and one dedicated persistent appdata directory. The template validates and initializes appdata ownership automatically, then runs SteamBee without root privileges as PUID/PGID. Do not map the appdata parent directory. Use only with Steam accounts you own. Review the project policy notice before using legacy boosting. Use an HTTPS reverse proxy when exposing SteamBee beyond a trusted LAN or VPN.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the SteamBee management UI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated SteamBee data directory. Ownership is validated and initialized automatically for PUID/PGID; do not select the appdata parent.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Numeric user ID used after appdata initialization. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Numeric group ID used after appdata initialization. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: Automatic Appdata Permissions
Config.Description: Initialize /data ownership for PUID/PGID, then permanently drop root privileges. Keep enabled on Unraid.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 for exactly one trusted reverse proxy, or provide trusted IP addresses/CIDRs.

Config.Name: Secure Cookie
Config.Description: Set to true when SteamBee is served through HTTPS.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace, or silent.

Config.Name: Quiet Request Logging
Config.Description: Suppress routine health and status requests in the logs.

Config.Name: Setup Token
Config.Description: Optional fixed setup token of 8 to 256 characters. Leave empty to generate one automatically.

Config.Name: Event Retention Days
Config.Description: Days to retain events. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup.
